title: Lab LCP 50.8s mobile
summary: Lab Largest Contentful Paint of 50.8 seconds on mobile causes most visitors to bounce before seeing content.
problem: Lab Largest Contentful Paint of 50.8 seconds on mobile causes most visitors to bounce before seeing content.
evidence: Lighthouse (mobile emulation, single synthetic run via DataForSEO): Largest Contentful Paint 50.8 s against a ‘good’ threshold of 2500ms. Lab data, not real-user field data — confirms the defect class, not the field percentile.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift
